CHEMISTRY — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia? (1 mark)
